command_powershell: foreach ($tool in 'psql','pg_isready','postgres','docker') { $found = Get-Command $tool -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "$tool=$([bool]$found)" }; $pgServices = @(Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'postgres|docker' -or $_.DisplayName -match 'postgres|docker' }); Write-Output "postgres_or_docker_services=$($pgServices.Count)"; Write-Output "postgres_install_directory=$(Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL')"; Write-Output "localhost_5432=$(Test-NetConnection -ComputerName 127.0.0.1 -Port 5432 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue -InformationLevel Quiet)"; foreach ($name in 'DATABASE_URL','PGHOST','PGPORT','PGDATABASE','PGUSER') { Write-Output "$name`_configured=$([bool][Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name))" }; python --version; python -m pip show Django psycopg
